summary: The fund pursues a buffered strategy that seeks to match the share price returns of the SPDR® S&P 500® ETF Trust (the “Underlying ETF”), at the end of a specified one-year period, from November 1 to October 31, subject to an upside maximum percentage return (the “Cap”) and downside protection with a buffer against the first 20.00% of Underlying ETF losses (the “Buffer”). It is non-diversified.
